## What & why

Implements the **bulk-offer ("clearance") posting model** described in `plans/active/freegle-helper-concierge.md` and validated by the Mind in Brighton case study: a single Freegle post (e.g. *"Office Clearance"*) carries a **structured catalogue of items** (name, quantity, condition, dimensions, photos), and recipients **tick the items they want and how many** — captured per-item against the catalogue. This is the foundation the Freegle Helper concierge operates on (allocation/automation is out of scope here).

Design: `plans/active/bulk-offer-clearance-design.md`.

## Data model (Laravel migrations — source of truth)
- `messages_bulk_items` — per-message catalogue (name, quantity, `condition`, dimensions, description)
- `messages_bulk_items_interest` — who wants what, how many, when they can collect, and state (`Interested`/`Reserved`/`Collected`/`Withdrawn`/`Rejected`); unique per (item, user)
- `messages_attachments.bulkitemid` — links a photo to a catalogue item (nullable; ON DELETE SET NULL)

A post is a bulk offer simply by having catalogue rows; it stays a normal `Offer` (no new message type, no `messages` migration).

## V2 Go API (`iznik-server-go`)
- `GET /message` returns `bulkitems[]` with photos grouped per item + an interest summary. The full per-user interest list is **owner/mod-only**; other viewers see only their own interest + counts.
- `PUT`/`PATCH /message` accept `bulkitems[]`. `availableinitially` tracks the total quantity; `textbody` falls back to a readable summary so non-bulk-aware consumers (search, V1 digest, plain-text email) still show the items.
- `POST /message` actions **`BulkInterest`** (one consolidated `Interested` chat reply, quantity capped at availability, idempotent re-express, qty 0 withdraws) and **`BulkInterestState`** (offerer/mod lifecycle transitions).

## Frontend (`iznik-nuxt3`)
- **`BulkItemEditor`** — add items as one-liners *or* paste/upload a spreadsheet (CSV; tolerant header + condition mapping).
- **`BulkItemsInterest`** — per-item checkbox + quantity stepper, shown in `MessageExpanded`; one click registers interest for the whole selection.
- **`pages/give/clearance.vue`** — post a whole clearance in one go, reusing the existing group/postcode/auth/submit flow.

## Email (`iznik-batch` UnifiedDigest — web & email parity)
The catalogue renders in the **MJML, AMP and plain-text** digest templates (thumbnail + quantity + name + condition rows), so recipients see the items in the email too.

## Tests (all green locally)
- Laravel: schema + cascade (`BulkOfferSchemaTest`, 5) and digest rendering (`UnifiedDigestBulkOfferTest`, 2)
- Go: handlers — create/read/interest/state/patch (`bulk_offer_test.go`, 5); full Go suite stays green (2984)
- Vitest: CSV parsing, editor logic, interest payload mapping (27)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Screenshots (from local Docker)

**Posting interface — the clearance composer** (items added by pasting a spreadsheet; one-liner rows with quantity, condition, dimensions and per-item photos; running total):

![Clearance composer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Freegle/Iznik/77efe372d1a6633e20537b8cfec78035be8993a3/plans/active/bulk-offer-screenshots/clearance-composer.png)

**Recipient view — per-item interest** (tick the items you want; ticking reveals a quantity stepper capped at availability and enables "Register interest", which sends the giver one consolidated message):

![Recipient interest view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Freegle/Iznik/77efe372d1a6633e20537b8cfec78035be8993a3/plans/active/bulk-offer-screenshots/recipient-interest.png)

commits.messageBody:
UnifiedDigest.preparePosts() adds a per-post 'bulkItems' catalogue (name,
quantity, condition label, dimensions, per-item thumbnail). The MJML, AMP and
plain-text digest templates render it as an item list so recipients see the
items in the email, not just on the web. Adds UnifiedDigestBulkOfferTest (2)
asserting the catalogue appears in the HTML+text parts and is absent for
ordinary posts. Both pass (full BulkOffer Laravel run: 7/7).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: feat(bulk-offer): render the catalogue in digest emails (MJML/AMP/text)

commits.messageBody:
- Re-expressing interest no longer resets an offerer-set Reserved/Collected/
  Rejected state (ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preserves it) — protects allocation.
- Re-expressing updates the single consolidated Interested chat message instead
  of posting a duplicate each time.
- Pure withdrawals (all qty 0) no longer create a ghost chat room.
- BulkInterestState returns 404 when the interest row doesn't exist.
- upsertBulkItems won't link an attachment already owned by another message
  (msgid IS NULL OR msgid = ? guard).
- PATCH rebuilds availableinitially/availablenow (incl. 0 when emptied) and the
  textbody summary.
- Message.bulkcount exposed; MessageSummary shows an 'N items' badge in lists.
- BulkItemsInterest guards against falsy item ids; use registered icons
  (list/gift) to avoid missing-icon console errors.
- Tests: re-express preserves Reserved (new); re-express doesn't add a 2nd chat
  message (new).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The test used a 1ms timeout on a real HTTP transport hoping the request
to ip-api.com would time out. On CI, ip-api.com responded fast enough
(DNS cache + quick connection) to beat the timeout, returning 200
instead of the expected 502.

Replace the timing-dependent approach with alwaysErrorTransport, a
RoundTripper that immediately returns a network error without touching
the real network — the same pattern as the existing errBodyTransport.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The test relied on a 1ms HTTP client timeout reliably firing to exercise the
network-error (502) path. On loaded CI VMs the request occasionally completed in
time and returned 200, so the test flaked (it surfaced as a build-and-test
failure on this PR's CI even though it is unrelated to the change, and passes on
master). Replace the timing-based simulation with an http.RoundTripper that
always errors, guaranteeing the 502 path deterministically.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

MessageExpanded now renders BulkItemsInterest, which uses b-form-checkbox /
b-form-group / b-form-input / b-badge. The global test setup only stubbed
b-button / b-card / b-form-select, so when MessageExpanded.spec mounted with bulk
data the unresolved b-form-checkbox tripped the warn-as-error guard and failed
'renders message-expanded-wrapper container'. Add these common bootstrap-vue-next
form components to the global stubs (consistent with the existing ones). Local
mount stubs still override, so no other spec is affected. Full vitest: 12875 pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

…r UX

Composer (BulkItemEditor):
- One photo uploader at the top feeding a tray; drag a photo onto a compact
  item row where it shows as a small thumbnail (rows are now single-line).
- New items appear at the top (next to the tray) — short drag, no scrolling.

Collection windows (messages_bulk_slots, new migration + Go load/upsert):
- Poster defines collection date/time windows on the clearance page.
- Responder picks one of those windows instead of typing a free-form time.

Responder view (BulkItemsInterest):
- Standard on/off toggle (switch) instead of a small checkbox; quantity stepper
  appears once toggled on; fixed-width pick column keeps rows consistent.

Non-structured channels (Trash Nothing / email): the textbody summary now lists
the items and the collection windows in plain text, so those repliers (and the
Freegle Helper that later structures their free-text replies) have the details.

Tests: Go 2986 incl. TestBulkOfferSlots; full Vitest 12875; Laravel BulkOffer 7.

commits.messageBody:
…s, AMP→web

Composer / import
- Pre-built static xlsx template asset (public/freegle-clearance-template.xlsx)
  with a condition drop-down, a whole-number quantity rule and a photo column;
  the import panel links to it and accepts pasted rows or a chosen CSV file.
- useBulkItems: auto-detect tab vs comma delimiter (so spreadsheet copy-paste
  works), recognise a photo/image/url column, skip "#" comment rows, and carry
  an http(s) photourl per item.

Server-side photo ingestion (Go)
- messages_bulk_items gains a photourl column (Laravel migration).
- On PUT/PATCH a background pass downloads each item's photourl and stores it as
  a real Freegle attachment linked to the item (reuses the TUS uploader), so a
  spreadsheet link becomes a proper photo. Idempotent; photourl stays as an
  immediate fallback until the upload lands.

Plain-text & email
- Item summaries carry reference numbers (1), 2) …) to disambiguate similar
  items for Trash Nothing / email repliers and the Freegle Helper — in the Go
  textbody summary and the MJML/AMP/text digest templates.
- AMP digest: bulk offers send the replier to the website ("Choose the items
  you'd like on the website") instead of the per-message AMP reply form, which
  can't capture a per-item, per-quantity selection.
- Digest falls back to the spreadsheet photourl thumbnail when an item has no
  uploaded attachment yet.

Tests
- Go: TestBulkItemPhotoIngestion (stubbed fetch + upload, asserts attachment
  created and idempotent); PUT test now covers photourl storage + ref numbers.
- Vitest: photo-URL column, comment-row skip and tab-separated paste parsing.
- Laravel: digest text reference numbers, AMP web-force link, photourl fallback.

commits.messageBody:
… build

Two CI failures on PR #618:

1. CircleCI (build 18579): Docker Hub rate-limit killing `docker-compose up`
   because the PR removed `registry-mirrors: ["http://185.44.254.6:5000"]`
   from daemon.json and moved the whole block inside SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER guard.
   Katapult cloud runners are NOT self-hosted, so the mirror setup was skipped
   entirely. Restore the full registry-mirror update (5000 + 5002) to run
   unconditionally for all runner types, keeping old-container cleanup in the
   self-hosted-only block. Publish orb as 1.1.330.

2. Netlify build: `BulkItemEditor.vue` used undefined SCSS variable
   `$color-gray--lightest` (only `$color-gray--lighter` exists) and was
   missing `bootstrap/scss/variables` + `bootstrap/scss/mixins/_breakpoints`
   imports required by `@include media-breakpoint-down(md)`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: fix(ci): restore Docker Hub registry-mirror + fix BulkItemEditor SCSS…

commits.messageBody:
… prod

cdnURL was `process.env.URL`, which Netlify sets to the production custom domain
(www.ilovefreegle.org) in EVERY context — including deploy previews and branch
deploys. So a preview's SSR HTML referenced /_nuxt chunks at www.ilovefreegle.org,
which only hosts production's chunks. A PR's newly-hashed chunks — including the
entry chunk that carries the route map — 404 there, so the whole app fails to boot
on the preview ("Failed to fetch dynamically imported module"); every page is dead,
not just new ones. (Confirmed via netlog: the preview requests
www.ilovefreegle.org/_nuxt/<entry>.js → 404.)

Keep production exactly as-is (CONTEXT==='production' → process.env.URL, proxied via
public/_redirects), but for preview/branch contexts reference the deploy's own
assets through the same-origin /netlify/<host> proxy that modtools already uses
(same-origin avoids Firefox CORS issues). This is what the original
"Use cdnURL to avoid missing chunk issues" commit was for.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.messageBody:
Composer UX (clearance page), per review feedback:
- Login required: show the sign-up modal immediately; remove the logged-out
  email flow entirely.
- Postcode moved to the top (it picks the community); one consistent green
  section-heading style across the whole page; fields reordered.
- Items shown as a table with column headings (Item / Qty / Condition / Size);
  quantity is a plain number box instead of a +/- stepper.
- Photos and the spreadsheet tool moved to a right-hand rail beside the items,
  and the photo uploader is more compact.
- Spreadsheet is upload-only now (paste removed). Accepts CSV/TSV and .xlsx —
  .xlsx is parsed in the browser via read-excel-file, lazy-imported so it never
  bloats the main bundle. parseItemsCsv now delegates to a shared parseItemsRows
  so xlsx rows and CSV text share one code path.

Access instructions (new):
- Optional offer-level note (exact address, gate code, intercom). Stored on
  messages.accessinstructions (Laravel migration; nullable, V1-safe).
- Returned by the Go API only to the offerer or a moderator — never to a plain
  viewer.
- Delivered to a replier via chat only once the offerer promises them an item
  (their interest moves to Reserved), and only once (not on every re-reserve).

Tests: Go TestBulkOfferAccessInstructions (store / owner-only visibility /
reveal-on-promise / no-duplicate); Vitest parseItemsRows (xlsx numeric cells);
updated BulkItemEditor spec for the upload-only flow. Go 2988, bulk Vitest 34,
Laravel 51 all green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: feat(bulk-offer): login-only composer rework + access instructions

commits.messageBody:
- "No Freegle community" warning only shows after a postcode is entered
  (was showing on load with an empty postcode).
- Description ("a few words") is taller and explains it applies to every item
  and must not contain anything you'd only share after agreeing someone can
  have an item — that's what Access instructions are for.
- Items: explicit choice between "Type them in" and "Upload a spreadsheet";
  the chosen method's UI is shown (and an import switches back to the table so
  the rows are visible/editable).
- Item-row inputs all fill their columns at a consistent size (were ragged).
- Collection times: state they're shown publicly and that we ask the replier
  to confirm.

DOCKERHUB_USERNAME / DOCKERHUB_TOKEN were set in CircleCI project env
vars but never used. Unauthenticated pulls hit the 100/6h rate limit
when multiple builds run close together; authenticated pulls get 200/6h.
Bump orb to 1.1.335 which adds the docker login step.

…preview

Composer:
- The items section now gates on an explicit choice — a prompt plus "Type them
  in" / "Upload a spreadsheet". Nothing (no table, no photos, no upload panel)
  shows until one is picked; importing a spreadsheet flips to the table so the
  rows can be edited.
- Newcomer intro explaining offers→chat and that you'll organise several
  Freeglers, with an invite to email geeks@ilovefreegle.org for the assisted
  version we're building.
- Optional "Closing date" — after it the offer disappears (passed through to
  submitDraft as the deadline). Blank = stays open.

ModTools:
- A bulk clearance in pending/approved now shows an info banner explaining it's
  a single post that members open to pick individual items, with a "See how
  members see it" button.
- New ModBulkPreviewModal: a member's-eye preview of the catalogue (photo, qty,
  condition, size, the per-item toggle) plus collection times.

Tests: ModBulkPreviewModal spec; BulkItemEditor mode-gate test. Bulk Vitest 42.

Vue 3 hoists resolveComponent() to the top of the render fn, so even
v-if=false components must be resolvable or they emit a [Vue warn] which
the test setup converts to a thrown error. Adds a minimal stub matching
the ~30 sibling Mod* stubs already in the file.
